contexts.text: Higher, or interior.
What is higher can see what takes place in what is lower, but not the reverse, AC 8237:end, Explained. AC 8977:end.
Looking from what is higher into what is lower; or, what is the same, from what is interior into what is exterior; is called influx, for it is effected by influx...
Interior things are expressed in the Word by higher ones, Explained.
From lower things no one can apprehend higher things...
For what is lower in man is perceived by what is higher. References.

To be elevated is said [of motion] from what is lower to what is higher, and therefore it = from what is exterior to what is interior... for what is lower and higher in a human idea is exterior and interior in an angelic idea; as Heaven, which appears to man as higher, but to the Angels it is interior...
Lower things are compounds of higher things. (See Degree.) AC 5114:3.
To intercept the communication and thence the conjunction between higher things and lower ones. Signified, Explained.
not to go erect = not to look to higher things, or those of Heaven.
As then... lower things began to have dominion over man's higher things, or natural things over his spiritual things...
The Lord's Kingdom in the ultimate of order, in which are higher things as in their house. Signified, Explained.
Whether you say higher and lower things, or interior and exterior ones, it is the same; for interior things appear before man as higher ones... AC 1005 1, References.
The things which are interior in the Spiritual World are described by higher ones... AC 4539:2.
Without an intermediate it is not possible to climb to higher things.
Interior things appear... as higher things.
No one can look at higher things from a lower mental view; to him higher things appear as darkness...
What is lower is as a scat to what is higher; for what is higher is and acts therein, and in fact through what is lower; and what is done appears as if it were from what is lower. Signified.
A higher Heaven. AC 5658:3.
What is higher can apperceive how the case is with that which is being done in what is lower. Explained.
For good is higher, and evil is lower.
It is entirely contrary to order... for what is lower to inflow into what is higher.

For when higher things inflow into lower ones they are no otherwise received (than according to correspondence)... All the conjunction... of lower things with higher is effected by it; for there is no correspondence unless, by subordination, lower things are subjected to higher; but when they are subjected, higher things act into lower ones exactly as the cause does into its effect.
No ascent to... a higher Heaven. Signified and Reference. AC 8797, Described.
Those of the Spiritual Kingdom cannot inflow into the Celestial Kingdom, because the latter is higher or interior...
Evil and falsity do not come forth from what is higher than themselves, but from what is lower...
The right of priority and superiority over the good of charity...
By higher things are signified interior things. AC 9961.
The things... nearest the fire of the altar were higher or interior... For, in the internal sense, those things are regarded as higher or interior which are nearest the Supreme.
It is according to Divine order, that when higher things fall down into lower, they are turned into like things...
What is interior is called higher, and what is exterior, lower... Hence it is evident what is meant by the lower... and higher Heavens.
The higher things of the body... are terminated in the hands.
(These Angels, and Heavens) are called interior, and also higher. Explained. HH 23:end. Explained.
[Swedenborg footnote 2.] That interior things are expressed by higher things, and that higher things = interior things. References. DLW 206. AE 283:2. AE 595:2, Explained.
For the Lord inflows from above...
The lumen of the world, separate from the light of higher things...
In a preceding article...
It cannot be believed in, on account of its superiority.
For if higher things do not rest upon their basis, they fall...

The reason the higher Heavens are meant, is that through them and from them influxes are effected into lower things, by which (influxes) the evil are separated... For there is such connection of the higher and lower things in the Spiritual World, that in proportion as lower things are in order, higher things are so. Explained.
Now as all higher things store themselves up in lowest things in simultaneous order...
